purpose: Create a US-index automatic demo forward-test candidate whose learned coefficients come from at least five years of historical data and whose later evaluation period is never used for fitting.
execution_note: The research history is the broker's US500 index series. Live execution symbol is configurable so the same signal can be mapped to a broker-supported US500/ES/MES-style contract. Options execution is intentionally not enabled because this repository does not contain five years of historical option-chain data.

training_protocol.leakage_rule: A training row is eligible only when both the feature timestamp and the forward target timestamp are on or before the cutoff.
training_protocol.post_cutoff_rule: All bars after the cutoff are validation/forward-simulation only. The model is never refit inside validation or the live runner.
training_protocol.learner: ridge regression fitted with numpy only
training_protocol.signal_threshold: 70th percentile of absolute in-sample predictions, measured on training only

safety.failed_backtest_behavior: runner refuses AUTO and reports the failed gate
